description: A ferry runs up a north-south fjord; its walls hide the satellites to the east and west, then the channel opens again.
trainer_note: Watch GSV: satellites low to the east and west keep their elevation and azimuth but lose their SNR as the walls rise, and are dropped from GSA; those along the channel keep their usual levels. HDOP grows and the fix may thin out. Nothing else moves: heading (HDT), water speed (VBW) and the track agree throughout. This is a blocked sky, not jamming: compare the GSV levels of the satellites still tracked with open-sea-jamming, where every level falls together.

events.description: Into the fjord: natural degradation: the sky closes behind a stated skyline (preset:fjord); satellites behind it stay listed with no SNR and are not used, the C/N0 of the rest is unchanged, and nothing is counterfeit from T+300 s for 660 s (onset ramp 120 s, recovery ramp 120 s)
